thread:
Maria (CS Manager): Heads up: We've identified intermittent embedding failures affecting several onboarding batches and a handful of dedicated customers. Need an aligned customer-facing status and mitigation commitments.
Ethan (CS Ops): Noted. Can we get a short bullets list of who to prioritize? Ill coordinate outreach slots.
Nina (Onboarding PM): Prioritize: HealthServe (onboarding), BrightRoute (large backfill), and KumoMedia (dedicated pool). HealthServe onboarding has the most urgent go-live impact.
Ravi (Eng Incident Lead): Technical summary: A backend batch scheduler misrouted large aggregated jobs to a node set undergoing an experimental quantization process, causing memory spikes and sporadic 503 errors from 01:45-03:30 UTC. Rollback executed at 03:35 UTC. Root cause RCA pending.
Claire (Account Executive): For HealthServe and BrightRoute, prepare a high-touch comm plan: phone + email, offer a 14-day capacity burst for HealthServe, monitoring session for BrightRoute. KumoMedia: standard credit + technical write-up.
Maria (CS Manager): Good. Drafting the customer note: clear impact, ETA to resolution, and remediation. Keep tone concise and own the fix.
Ethan (CS Ops): Quick ask: include a recommended next step for customers who saw partial imports: re-run backfill or contact onboarding support.
Ravi (Eng Incident Lead): Monitoring currently shows token throughput normalizing. ETA for backlog drain: ~4 hours. Customer-facing RCA blurb: "An internal optimization was deployed to a small subset of serving instances which increased resource contention for certain batch shapes. We reverted the change and have implemented a rollout stop while we validate canary metrics."
Maria (CS Manager): I'll post 2 variants of the message (onboarding + production) in this thread for review.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-048 created by Ravi at 2026-03-18T03:37:12Z. Severity: P2.
Maria (CS Manager): Draft message (onboarding): "Short: You may have experienced failures or partial results during onboarding backfills between 01:45-03:35 UTC. Impact: some backfills retried automatically; if your imports still show missing vectors, please re-run the backfill or reply and we'll prioritize. Mitigation: rollback complete and backlog draining. Offer: 14-day free capacity burst for urgent go-live customers. Next steps: we'll share RCA when available."
Claire (Account Executive): Add sentence about credits being tracked in billing.
Nina (Onboarding PM): Add recommended re-run threshold: if >5% of records missing, re-run and we'll assist.
Maria (CS Manager): Updated draft posted. Sending to HealthServe and KumoMedia in 15m unless objections.
Claire (Account Executive): Finance confirmed 14-day burst OK for HealthServe. I'll loop them in after send.
Ravi (Eng Incident Lead): Long-term actions: add pre-deployment memory checks for quantize jobs and automated canary size gating. Creating ticket INC-2026-048-A2.
Maria (CS Manager): Sending now. Will paste the sent email text below once sent.
Maria (CS Manager): Sent to HealthServe & KumoMedia at 10:58 UTC. I'll follow up with BrightRoute separately.
Ethan (CS Ops): Thanks. Please post any replies here and well coordinate next steps.
Claire (Account Executive): If HealthServe requests extended credits, escalate to CS leadership.
Maria (CS Manager): Closing thread for drafting; reopen if any customer replies or new engineering updates.
